security_title: ADS originally representing a fraction of a preference share
notes: SEC News Digest records SAP AG F-1 filed Jun 22 1998 for PREFERRED STOCK. A Jun 23 F-6 used the generic label 'Depositary Receipts for Common Stock', but SAP's later issuer 20-F definitively states that the ADSs listed on NYSE effective Aug 3 1998 originally represented a fraction of a preference share and only became ordinary-share-backed after the 2001 conversion. Thus the 1998 Orion row is non-common. The Jul 7 1998 Orion buy also predates the documented Aug 3 1998 NYSE ADS listing and is separately flagged as a tradability anomaly.
